question: Should per-agent dashboard grouping and whole-agent collapse be accepted as a bundled dashboard-plugin roadmap item after Wave 1, or kept outside core for now?
rationale: Current main lacks the dashboard workspace substrate, and the open prerequisite stack has product, compatibility, and security implications that automation cannot sequence safely.

options.title: Defer Behind Wave 1
options.body: Keep this issue open as the narrow Tier 3 child and revisit once the dashboard workspace/store/UI stack is merged or rejected.

options.title: Sponsor On The Stack
options.body: Ask the contributor to implement this against the dashboard stack and accept the extra stacked review burden now.

options.title: Route Outside Core
options.body: Decline bundled dashboard ownership and ask for an external plugin/prototype until maintainers approve the dashboard product direction.

recommendation.title: Defer Behind Wave 1
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the narrow Tier 3 child and revisit once the dashboard workspace/store/UI stack is merged or rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI navigation/collapse work makes this the best available owner signal for the product sequencing question.
